results.acceptance: Signature trust policy and unavailable checkpoint status are explicit; hash chain alone is not immutable.

verification_details.trust_policy: Explicit TrustPolicy enforces authorized Ed25519 public keys, allowed algorithm whitelist, timestamp age/skew bounds, and minimum accepted sequence.
verification_details.explicit_statuses: VerificationResult yields explicit typed statuses including TRUSTED, UNAVAILABLE, UNTRUSTED_SIGNER, INVALID_SIGNATURE, TAMPERED_LOG, STALE_REVISION, REPLAY_REJECTED, EXPIRED, and UNANCHORED_CHAIN.
verification_details.hash_chain_alone_not_immutable: VerifyUnanchored explicitly refuses TRUSTED status (returns UNANCHORED_CHAIN) for any unanchored event stream.
verification_details.one_modified_byte: One modified byte in event payload produces TAMPERED_LOG; one modified byte in checkpoint log root or signature produces INVALID_SIGNATURE.
verification_details.stale_and_replayed_revisions: Sequence monotonicity is strictly enforced; sequence <= accepted authority is rejected as STALE_REVISION or REPLAY_REJECTED and cannot overwrite the accepted authority.
verification_details.separate_sink: DirectoryCheckpointStore implements atomic persistence via write-and-rename and separate directory storage; FailingCheckpointStore proves UNAVAILABLE handling during sink failures.
verification_details.canary_absence: Exhaustive scans across test checkpoints, CloudEvents, and verification results demonstrate zero occurrences of the plaintext canary.
